fields.trust.title: Tools to understand your options. Not promises about outcomes.
fields.trust.description: MyMI Wallet focuses on financial organization and information. Feature availability varies; market data and investments involve risk, and information on the platform is not personalized investment advice.
fields.faq.title: A few things worth knowing
fields.faq.one.question: What is MyMI Wallet?
fields.faq.one.answer: A personal finance workspace centered on budgeting, financial goals, investment tracking, and financial information.
fields.faq.two.question: Can I use MyMI Wallet to make investment decisions?
fields.faq.two.answer: The platform is designed to help organize and review information, not guarantee returns or replace personalized advice from a qualified professional.
fields.faq.three.question: How do I get started?
fields.faq.three.answer: Create an account, explore the dashboard, and begin with the financial areas most important to you. Available tools and integrations may vary.
fields.closing.title: Your next financial decision starts with a clearer view.
